name: Xenobot Kinematics Simulator
description: Simulates the collective kinematics of xenobot-inspired multicellular constructs. Each cell is represented by an (motor_x, motor_y) force vector; the simulator integrates individual trajectories over configurable steps using NumPy vector addition, computes net centroid displacement, and returns a dual-panel matplotlib trajectory plot encoded as a base64 PNG alongside a plain-text summary.

inputs.name: cells
inputs.description: List of cell configuration dicts. Each dict must contain 'motor_x' (float, µm/step) and 'motor_y' (float, µm/step). An optional 'label' (str) key sets the legend entry for that cell.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Number of simulation time-steps to integrate. Defaults to 50.

inputs.name: noise
inputs.description: Standard deviation (µm) of Gaussian noise injected per cell per step. Defaults to 0.05.

outputs.description: A dictionary with a 'content' key containing a list of two blocks: [0] a text block with the plain-text simulation summary (cell count, steps, net motor vector, net displacement, final centroid position); [1] an image block with 'data' (base64-encoded PNG) and 'media_type' ('image/png') of the dual-panel trajectory plot.
